title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.1.5 — High-Accuracy Fused Engine & Native Offline Movement Queue
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.1.5:
• Google Fused Location Engine: real sensor-fusion tracking across Wi-Fi, GPS, and sensors for tight 10m background movement detection
• Native SharedPreferences offline queue: zero lost movement coordinates when offline; auto-flushed the second internet reconnects
• Clean status notification: 'Active & Guarding' without clutter
• Single authentic GPS lock: removed false IP location overrides permanently
